name: Boston Globe
notes: Rolling 72-hour access. The form must be resubmitted before it lapses; that is the whole reason this service exists.

name: The New York Times
notes: Static gift code redeemed once against your NYT login. Not a rolling window, so there is nothing to renew. Enable only if you want the current redemption link surfaced.

name: The Wall Street Journal
notes: Static partner redemption link; requires an interactive WSJ login to redeem.

name: The Washington Post
notes: Static special-offer sign-in link; requires an interactive Post login to redeem.
